evidence.quote: Our building has step-free access via the front entrance, and throughout the upper section of the ground floor.
there’s no lift to the Circle seating upstairs, and this can only be accessed via 43 steps to our upper level.
Our accessible toilet is located in the left-hand side of the foyer through the main entrance, and is accessible via Radar key.
Everyone’s welcome at Troxy – our team will always do their best to accommodate you and make sure your visit is relaxed, welcoming and accessible.

findings.value: The Circle is reached only by 43 steps with no lift, and Front Stalls are three steps down. One free carer ticket comes with each accessible ticket. The accessibility team can be emailed at accesstickets@troxy.co.uk, and staff monitor that inbox on weekday office hours. Hot Pink Wristbands are available for non-visible conditions. The only hearing loop named is at the box office window.

evidence.quote: Front Stalls tickets are not step-free accessible, as the lower ground floor area at the front of the auditorium is only accessible via 3 steps down from the upper ground floor.
The accessible ticket policy limits one free carer ticket to each accessible ticket purchased.
You can contact our accessibility team directly at accesstickets@troxy.co.uk
this inbox is typically monitored from 10am-6pm, Monday to Friday.
Hot Pink Wristbands are a discreet and simple way to indicate non-visible disabilities/conditions
We have a hearing loop system in place at our box office window.
